description: Declaring that the Area of Land comprising the Badulla Katharagma Devala as Sacred Area and Urban Development Area and directing that an outline physical plan be prepared for the whole area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically declaring an area as an "Urban Development Area" called the "Badulla Katharagama Devala Sacred Area" and providing detailed land descriptions including lot numbers, boundaries, survey plans, and location details. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickramasinghe, it does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather uses the minister's authority to make a land-related declaration under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance.
